daily.topThemeTitle: Fall Conference Calendar Fills In From Thessaloniki to Columbia
daily.topThemeBody: 1EdTech hosts a Spanish-language assessment webinar today ahead of its Learning Impact Europe conference in Thessaloniki September 15-17, while THE Journal's Tech Tactics in Education goes virtual September 23 and Ed-Fi's Alliance Summit and EdTech Week's Columbia gathering round out the fall calendar.

heroWeek.themeTitle: AI Surveillance and Classroom Policy Draw New Scrutiny
heroWeek.themeBody: Brookings finds AI-powered school surveillance tools deployed disproportionately in low-income, high-minority districts, while EdSurge's on-the-ground reporting shows new edtech and screen-time guidance is easier to write than to apply in a real classroom.
